items.title: Stock Market LIVE: Sensex at day's high, up 500 pts; Nifty tops 23,950; Tata Chemicals falls 2%
items.description: Sensex Today | Stock Market LIVE Updates Friday: In the broader markets, the Nifty MidCap fell 0.04 and the Nifty SmallCap rose 0.46 per cent

items.title: Can UltraTech's cables & wire foray charge up its shares? What analysts say
items.description: Brokerages believe the positioning appears more aggressive than initially envisaged, also tallying with Grasim's rollout in paints, and could add materially to UltraTech's FY30 revenue.

items.title: Tribhovandas Bhimji Zaveri soars 58% in 4 days; zooms 107% from Aug low
items.description: TBZ share price hit a new high of ₹480.85 on Friday, surging 93% over its open offer price of ₹249.61 per share.

items.title: 'Ultravolt' shock! Polycab, KEI & others crash up to 8% on de-rating fears
items.description: Nuvama said UltraTech's scale ambition could intensify industry competition and its aggressive posturing on capacity, portfolio, and distribution could drive an interim de-rating for C&W industry

items.title: Tata Chemicals dips 2.5% on Kenya exit buzz; co. issues clarification
items.description: Ruto on Thursday ordered the ousting of Tata Chemicals Ltd. and is said to be looking for fresh investors to take over its century-old mining rights for minerals that are processed into soda ash.

items.title: CAS review: Nifty Capital Market index jumps 2%; Angel One, BSE lead rally
items.description: According to reports, the market regulator Sebi is set to issue a consultation paper in a week proposing changes to the methodology used for determining settlement prices of derivative contracts.

items.title: Bumper debut! ESDS Software shares list at 76% premium over IPO price
items.description: ESDS Software's share price listed at ₹757 apiece on the National Stock Exchange (NSE) as against the offer price of ₹429, a premium of 76.46 per cent.

items.title: Priority Jewels makes firm debut, lists at 15% premium on NSE
items.description: Priority Jewels shares listed at ₹225 on the BSE, a premium of 12.60 per cent against the offer price of ₹200. Meanwhile, on the National Stock Exchange, it debuted at ₹230, up 15 per cent.

items.title: Has Nifty bottomed out? Tech analysts decode charts; flag key levels
items.description: Technical analysts flag presence of multiple hurdles in the 24,000-24,200 region for the Nifty; on the downside, they expect immediate support at 23,800.

items.title: Asian shares climb as Fed rate hike fears ease ahead of US jobs data
items.description: Asian shares rose as investors awaited key US jobs data, while the yen rallied 2.6% this week after Fed Governor Christopher Waller eased fears of a rate hike

items.title: Stocks to watch: UltraTech, Cipla, Sterlite, Tata Power, OMCs & more
items.description: Aditya Birla Group forayed into the wires and cables market with an investment of ₹1,800 crore. The new business will operate through its cement arm UltraTech Cement, under the Ultravolt brand.

items.title: Sensex zooms 730 pts intraday, Nifty reclaims 24K: What's driving markets?
items.description: The BSE barometer Sensex rallied 730 points or 0.95 per cent to 76,883, while the Nifty 50 index gained 132 points or 0.55 per cent to reclaim 24,000. The index hit the day's peak of 24,005.

items.title: ACME Solar rallies 7%, hits new high; stock up 120% from CY2026 low
items.description: Looking ahead, ACME Solar said it is steadily executing its long-term growth plan to scale up to 10 GW of generation capacity alongside 25 GWh of battery storage capacity by 2030.

items.title: RIL shares rise 2% as strong O2C growth lifts Q2 earnings outlook
items.description: Today's buying in RIL came after Nuvama reiterated its 'Buy' rating on the stock, with a target price of ₹1,766. The target implies an upside of nearly 36 per cent from the previous close of ₹1,301.05

items.title: NSE IPO anticipation: New India Assurance zooms 17%; IFCI jumps 12%
items.description: Share price of New India Assurance Company hit a 52-week high of ₹229.30, surging 17 per cent on the BSE on the back of six-fold jump in trading volume.

items.title: Oil may top $100 as Hormuz, Russia risks persist: Mirae Asset Sharekhan
items.description: Mirae Asset Sharekhan believes that the crude oil market balance is likely to remain in deficit through 2026.

items.title: Silver outlook: Dovish Fed eases pressure; Mirae Asset sees support at $65
items.description: Mirae Asset Sharekhan said dovish Fed commentary has eased downside pressure on silver, but high China inventories, subdued LBMA lease rates and weak ETF flows remain concerns.

items.title: Physicswallah shares rise nearly 7% post block deal, MOFSL's bullish view
items.description: MOFSL noted that Physicswallah is among India's largest education platforms, built on what the brokerage believes is one of the most capital-efficient business models in Indian EdTech.

items.title: STL hits 5% upper limit on Growth Roadmap FY27-29; up 786% from CY2026 low
items.description: Sterlite Technologies is targeting ₹20,000 crore revenue by the FY29 vs ₹4,750 crore FY26 - roughly 4x growth and EBITDA margin targeted to rise from 13% in FY26 to >27% in FY29.

items.title: Motilal OFS, CRISIL, CUB among 4 breakout stocks identified by analysts
items.description: Technical analysts Drumil Vithlani and Ved Anil Gawker flag breakout from consolidation chart patterns on Motilal OFS, CRISIL, City Union Bank and Supreme Petrochem.

items.title: Gold: Crude, inflation key threats; analyst sees $4400 as tactical buy zone
items.description: Mirae Asset ShareKhan's Praveen Singh said that gold's key support levels are at $4,450, $4,358, and $4,300-4,330, while resistance is seen at $4,533, $4,575, and $4,650.
